title: Replay test: assert the replay key's attempt count only after the worker settles the receipt
outcome: retryable_remote_responses_replay_the_same_request_instead_of_refusing_it counts same-key attempts only after the worker has settled the replay receipt, so a stray third same-key attempt cannot escape detection.
acceptance: The test waits on an explicit worker completion or idle event, asserts the matching envelope is Recorded, and then counts attempts for the replay key.
Optionally, it also asserts that every unadmitted_turn request for the same host_turn_ref carries the replay key.
No assertion rests on wall-clock duration; a two-vendor review has no Medium or higher finding.
